newsitem.title: FRANCE: French October new car sales up 24.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: French October new car sales up 24.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: New car sales in France rose 24.7 percent in October over the year-earlier period, the French carmakers association CCFA said on Monday.
It said new car sales rose to 202,482 last month from 162,360 in October 1995.
For the first ten months of the year, new car sales were 14.7 percent higher.
New car sales by PSA Peugeot Citroen were 5.9 percent higher at 55,717, Peugeot car sales were up 13.1 percent at 35,692 while Citroen sales fell 4.9 percent to 20,023.
Renault car sales were up 28.7 percent to 56,363.
Sales of new cars by foreign carmakers were up 37.2 percent to 90,380.
GM Europe sales were up 28.6 percent at 12,554.
Ford new car sales were 37.2 percent higher at 17,304.
Fiat sales were up 74.1 percent at 18,969
BMW/Rover sales were up 0.5 percent to 5,489 while Mercedes Benz sales rose 16.3 to 2,401.
Combined new car sales by Japanese manufacturers were 38.9 percent higher at 8,742.
